attr.title: Chessing
attr.desc: Chess puzzle trainer for handhelds with 38,367 puzzles from the Lichess puzzle database, sorted into 10 difficulty levels and 19 themes. It keeps a rating that goes up when you solve a puzzle on the first try and down when you miss, remembers which puzzles you have already seen, and includes four board looks and sound effects.
attr.inst: Ready to run out of the box, no additional files needed.
